Name: NoEasyFix
Description: Standard BattleMechs keep their stock layout: leftover empty slots stay locked, while OmniMechs keep that space. A different kind of gear costs more to install; repairs and like-for-like swaps do not. Refit kits in a faction's stores upgrade an older hull to a later variant from the mech bay. Slot lock and refit kits can each be turned off in the mod settings.
Author: Blacknova
